Name: Family
Author: scrotorrr
Description:
Have you ever thought "why is there a lonely parrot at Emily's house when the parrotboy Leo is living in Pelican Town??"  I have.  And I was tired of them being apart, so I made a small mod where we can see Leo meeting the bird!  Just 2 events and a few short lines of dialogue, but this mini-expansion filled a hole in my heart that only a parrot could fill.  I hope you enjoy it as much as I do.


In the screenshots, I'm using Enhanced Emily Revised and Seasonal Improved Leo mods to made the two of them look cameraworthy <3

Downloads.Description: Corrects the # of hearts needed to trigger events so that Leo is in town first.

Manifest.Name: Family
Manifest.Description: Forms connection between Leo and Emily's parrot
